title: Chapter 485 Unifying The World
content:
Chapter 485 Unifying The World

In this situation, whoever strikes first will suffer.

The last one to strike usually gets the biggest advantage.

The Mininia Empire did not send troops at the same time as the Maka Empire. It is obvious that they are planning to reap the benefits.

As long as the Wana Empire's troops are consumed by half, the final winner of this battle will be the Mininia Empire.

Wang Shuo knows very well that it is not difficult to deal with the Maka Empire.

The difficulty is that it is surrounded by two empires and cannot take care of both ends.

After careful consideration, Wang Shuo decided that he and Gong Zheng would stay, and Ayub would lead Zhao Bangde and all the other kings to attack the Maka Empire with all their strength.

More than 40 strongest kings, fighting more than 20, this is completely unsuspenseful.

With the cooperation of ordinary soldiers.

At the beginning of the battle, it was a one-sided situation.

The emperor of the Mininia Empire, seeing this situation, could only secretly curse the Maka Empire as a group of idiots.

If you don't join the battle now, I'm afraid that the opportunity will be lost if you wait for a few more hours.

The city gate opened, and the main force of the Mininia Empire also went out.

Just after the commander walked out of the city gate, Wang Shuo also started to move.

He asked Gong Zheng to sit on the back of the Demon King, and he sat on the back of the Ice Phoenix King.

He rushed straight to the commander on the opposite side.

This was to carry out a decapitation operation.

This sudden change shocked the emperor of the Mininia Empire standing on the city wall.

He didn't have the courage to fight in person.

He just wanted to mobilize more masters to go to support.

But it was obviously a little late.

The Ice Phoenix King used a big move "Ice Thousand Miles".

All the low-level soldiers around were frozen.

Only the masters at the level of generals were still able to move.

This move was just to clear the field.

The Demon King spit out another flame.

The two worlds of ice and fire caused many masters at the level of generals to be seriously injured.

Gong Zheng found the right time and used a move "Taishan Pressing the Top" to hit the enemy's military marshal.

Wang Shuo used the "Great Dragon".

The golden dragon, with the force of thunder and lightning, smashed fiercely at the opponent's military marshal, and immediately beat him to spit blood.

If he didn't have any life-saving items, I'm afraid this set of combined attacks would have killed him.

But even if he saved his life, he had lost his fighting ability and fell to the ground, dying.

After a successful attack, Wang Shuo didn't dare to fight.

He took his men and pets and flew far away, continuing to watch.

It was obvious that Wang Shuo's move was to warn the Mininian Empire.

If you dare to intervene, I will find the right time to directly attack your king's high-level.

"Shameless." The emperor of the Mininian Empire was so angry that his teeth itched, but he couldn't think of any good countermeasures.

On the other side, Ayub swept the Maka Empire with a crushing force.

Then, the army attacked the Mininian Empire and captured the capital two days later.

At this point, the war came to an end.

The Wana Empire won a great victory.

It took another two years for the Wana Empire to unify the Shenwu Empire.

On this day.

Wang Shuo came to Shenwu City, the capital of the Shenwu Empire.

After everyone's discussion, the Wana Empire decided to make Shenwu City its capital.

This place is well connected and is almost located in the center of the entire empire, which has a strong deterrent effect on all directions.

The entire capital is decorated with lights and colorful flags and lanterns everywhere.

Because today is the day for their great emperor to announce to the world.

At the same time, it is also the day to marry the queen and confer the title to the world.

Wang Shuo followed the etiquette and worshiped the heaven and earth.

Of course, Wang Shuo knew in his heart that worshiping the heaven and earth was useless.

If there is anything, it is better to go to Lord Zak.

Then, the meritorious officials were enfeoffed.

Wang Shuo did not want to adopt this system of enfeoffment.

But on second thought, what does it matter?

As long as it is strong, the country will not fall apart.

If the royal family weakens, there will always be forces that rise up, which is an unstoppable fact.

It is better to follow the previous system, after all, the world is too big.

It is impossible for a central agency to control everything.

For example, population statistics.

There is almost no way to do this. By the time the grassroots report to the central government, it may have been several years.

Moreover, it is really disheartening if the brothers who followed him to conquer the world are not given fiefs.
